subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: Should OpenClaw expose or reuse a bounded operator-configurable cap for generic media-store and sandbox staging, or keep the 5 MiB generic cap and land only narrow channel/document exceptions?
rationale: The source-level issue is clear, but the broad fix changes resource-limit defaults/config and sandbox media exposure, which repository policy treats as product and security-sensitive.

options.title: Approve Bounded Core Cap
options.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract for media store, sandbox staging, and reply-media defaults, with schema/help/docs and regression coverage.

options.title: Land Narrow Exceptions Only
options.body: Keep the generic 5 MiB cap and land focused exceptions only where downstream channel limits and real proof justify them.

options.title: Document The Safety Limit
options.body: Treat the 5 MiB generic staging cap as intentional, document the separate cap, and leave larger files to explicit channel/tool paths.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Core Cap
recommendation.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract for media store, sandbox staging, and reply-media defaults, with schema/help/docs and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The media-store and sandbox-staging history plus cross-cutting security/config policy point most directly to this owner for the product decision.
